name: proofpoint-threat-response
label: Proofpoint Threat Response
description: Proofpoint Threat Response is a solution designed to help organizations manage and respond to cybersecurity threats. It provides tools and features to identify, investigate, and remediate security incidents.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.name: server_url
fields.tooltip: Specify the URL of the Proofpoint Threat Response server to connect and perform automated operations.
fields.description: Specify the URL of the Proofpoint Threat Response server to connect and perform automated operations.

fields.title: Username
fields.name: username
fields.description: Specify the username used to access the Proofpoint Threat Response server to connect and perform automated operations.
fields.tooltip: Specify the username used to access the Proofpoint Threat Response server to connect and perform automated operations.

fields.title: Password
fields.name: password
fields.description: Specify the password used to access the Proofpoint Threat Response server to connect and perform automated operations.
fields.tooltip: Specify the password used to access the Proofpoint Threat Response server to connect and perform automated operations.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set to True.
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set to True.

operations.title: Get Indicators List
operations.description: Retrieves all indicators from the specified list.

parameters.name: list_id
parameters.title: List ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the list whose indicators you want to retrieve.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the list whose indicators you want to retrieve.

operations.title: Add Indicators
operations.description: Adds the specified indicators to the specified list.

parameters.name: list_id
parameters.title: List ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the list to which you want to add the specified indicators.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the list to which you want to add the specified indicators.

parameters.name: indicator
parameters.title: Indicator
parameters.description: Specify the indicator values to add to the list. Values can be IP addresses, URLs, domains, or file hashes. For example, 192.168.1.1,192.168.1.2.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the indicator values to add to the list. Values can be IP addresses, URLs, domains, or file hashes. For example, 192.168.1.1,192.168.1.2.

parameters.name: description
parameters.title: Comment
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the comment to add with this operation.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the comment to add with this operation.

parameters.name: expiration
parameters.title: Expiration
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the expiration of the indicator.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the expiration of the indicator.

parameters.name: indicator
parameters.title: IP Address
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of IP addresses to add to the block list.
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of IP addresses to add to the block list.

parameters.name: list_id
parameters.title: Blocklist ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the IP address block list.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the IP address block list.

parameters.name: expiration
parameters.title: Expiration
parameters.description: Specify the date and time at which the specified IP addresses should be removed from the block list.
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the date and time at which the specified IP addresses should be removed from the block list.

operations.title: Block Domain
operations.description: Blocks the specified domains by adding them to the specified domain block list.

parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of domains to add to the block list.

parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the domain block list.

parameters.tooltip: Specify the date and time at which the specified domains should be removed from the block list.

operations.title: Search Indicator
operations.description: Retrieves indicators from the specified list, based on the filter you have specified.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.title: Filter
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the filter to use for the indicator search. For example, specifying 1.1 returns 1.1.1.1, 22.22.1.1, and 1.1.22.22.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the filter to use for the indicator search. For example, specifying 1.1 returns 1.1.1.1, 22.22.1.1, and 1.1.22.22.

parameters.name: list_id
parameters.title: Blocklist ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the list in which you want to search.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the list in which you want to search.

operations.title: Delete Indicator
operations.description: Removes an indicator from Proofpoint Threat Response based on the input parameters you have specified.

parameters.name: list_id
parameters.title: List ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the list from which you want to delete the specified indicator.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the list from which you want to delete the specified indicator.

parameters.name: indicator_id
parameters.title: Indicator ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the indicator that you want to delete from the list.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the indicator that you want to delete from the list.

operations.title: Get Incident By ID
operations.description: Retrieves the metadata of the specified incident from Proofpoint Threat Response.

parameters.name: incident_id
parameters.title: Incident ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the incident whose details you want to retrieve.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the incident whose details you want to retrieve.

parameters.name: expand_events
parameters.title: Expand Events
parameters.description: Select this option to return full event objects in the response. If you clear this option, an array of event IDs is returned instead, which significantly speeds up the response time of the API for incidents that contain a large number of alerts.
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to return full event objects in the response. If you clear this option, an array of event IDs is returned instead, which significantly speeds up the response time of the API for incidents that contain a large number of alerts.

operations.title: Get Incidents List
operations.description: Retrieves metadata for all incidents from Proofpoint Threat Response, based on the filter criteria you have specified, such as the state of the incident or its time of closure.

parameters.name: state
parameters.title: State
parameters.description: (Optional) Select the state of the incidents that you want to retrieve. You can choose from New, Open, Assigned, Closed, and Ignored.
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Select the state of the incidents that you want to retrieve. You can choose from New, Open, Assigned, Closed, and Ignored.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.title: Create After
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the date and time to retrieve incidents that were created after this date and time.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the date and time to retrieve incidents that were created after this date and time.

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.title: Created Before
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the date and time to retrieve incidents that were created before this date and time.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the date and time to retrieve incidents that were created before this date and time.

parameters.name: closed_after
parameters.title: Closed After
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the date and time to retrieve incidents that were closed after this date and time.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the date and time to retrieve incidents that were closed after this date and time.

parameters.name: closed_before
parameters.title: Closed Before
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the date and time to retrieve incidents that were closed before this date and time.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the date and time to retrieve incidents that were closed before this date and time.

parameters.name: expand_events
parameters.title: Expand Events
parameters.description: (Optional) Select this option to return full event objects in the response. If you clear this option, an array of event IDs is returned instead, which significantly speeds up the response time of the API for incidents that contain a large number of alerts.
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to return full event objects in the response. If you clear this option, an array of event IDs is returned instead, which significantly speeds up the response time of the API for incidents that contain a large number of alerts.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.title: Limit
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the maximum number of incidents that this operation should return. By default, this is set to 50.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the maximum number of incidents that this operation should return. By default, this is set to 50.

parameters.tooltip: Specify the comment to add to the specified incident.

parameters.name: description

parameters.tooltip: Specify the description to add with this operation.

parameters.name: comment

parameters.name: targets

parameters.tooltip: Specify the list of targets to add to the specified incident.

parameters.name: attackers

parameters.tooltip: Specify the list of attackers to add to the specified incident.

operations.title: Ingest Alert
operations.description: Ingests an alert into Proofpoint Threat Response based on the input parameters you have specified.

parameters.name: json_version
parameters.title: JSON Version
parameters.description: Specify the Proofpoint Threat Response JSON version. You can choose from 2.0 and 1.0. By default, this is set to 2.0.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the Proofpoint Threat Response JSON version. You can choose from 2.0 and 1.0. By default, this is set to 2.0.

parameters.name: post_url_id
parameters.title: Post URL ID
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the POST URL of the JSON alert source. You can find this URL by navigating to Sources > JSON event source > POST URL.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the POST URL of the JSON alert source. You can find this URL by navigating to Sources > JSON event source > POST URL.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.title: Attacker
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify an attacker object, in the JSON format: {"attacker": {...}}. The attacker object must contain one of the following keys: ip_address, mac_address, host_name, url, or user. You can also add the port key to this object. For more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.
parameters.tooltip: Specify an attacker object, in the JSON format: {"attacker": {...}}. The attacker object must contain one of the following keys: ip_address, mac_address, host_name, url, or user. You can also add the port key to this object. For more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.

parameters.name: classification
parameters.title: Classification
parameters.description: (Optional) Select the alert classification, which is displayed as Alert Type in the Proofpoint Threat Response UI. You can choose from Malware, Policy Violation, Vulnerability, Network, Spam, Phish, Command and Control, Data Match, Authentication, System Behavior, Impostor, Reported Abuse, and Unknown.
parameters.tooltip: Select the alert classification, which is displayed as Alert Type in the Proofpoint Threat Response UI. You can choose from Malware, Policy Violation, Vulnerability, Network, Spam, Phish, Command and Control, Data Match, Authentication, System Behavior, Impostor, Reported Abuse, and Unknown.

parameters.name: cnc_hosts
parameters.title: CNC Hosts
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the command and control host information, in the JSON format: {"cnc_hosts": [{"host": "-", "port": "-"}, ...]}. Every item of the cnc_hosts list is in the JSON format. For more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the command and control host information, in the JSON format: {"cnc_hosts": [{"host": "-", "port": "-"}, ...]}. Every item of the cnc_hosts list is in the JSON format. For more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.

parameters.name: detector
parameters.title: Detector
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the threat detection tool, such as a firewall or an IPS/IDS system, that generated the original alert, in the JSON format: {"detector": {...}}. For all the relevant JSON fields and for more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the threat detection tool, such as a firewall or an IPS/IDS system, that generated the original alert, in the JSON format: {"detector": {...}}. For all the relevant JSON fields and for more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.

parameters.name: email
parameters.title: Email
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the email metadata related to the alert, in the JSON format: {"email": {...}}. For all the relevant JSON fields and for more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the email metadata related to the alert, in the JSON format: {"email": {...}}. For all the relevant JSON fields and for more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.

parameters.name: forensics_hosts
parameters.title: Forensics Hosts
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the forensics host information, in the JSON format: {"forensics_hosts": [{"host": "-", "port": "-"}, ...]}. Every item of the forensics_hosts list is in the JSON format. For more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the forensics host information, in the JSON format: {"forensics_hosts": [{"host": "-", "port": "-"}, ...]}. Every item of the forensics_hosts list is in the JSON format. For more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.

parameters.name: link_attribute
parameters.title: Link Attribute
parameters.description: (Optional) Select the attribute to link to the alerts. You can choose from Target IP Address, Target Hostname, Target Machine Name, Target User, Target Mac Address, Attacker IP Address, Attacker Hostname, Attacker Machine Name, Attacker User, Attacker Mac Address, Email Recipient, Email Sender, Email Subject, Message ID, Threat Filename, and Threat Filehash.
parameters.tooltip: Select the attribute to link to the alerts. You can choose from Target IP Address, Target Hostname, Target Machine Name, Target User, Target Mac Address, Attacker IP Address, Attacker Hostname, Attacker Machine Name, Attacker User, Attacker Mac Address, Email Recipient, Email Sender, Email Subject, Message ID, Threat Filename, and Threat Filehash.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.title: Severity
parameters.description: (Optional) Select the severity of the alert. You can choose from Info, Minor, Moderate, Major, Critical, Informational, Low, Medium, and High.
parameters.tooltip: Select the severity of the alert. You can choose from Info, Minor, Moderate, Major, Critical, Informational, Low, Medium, and High.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.title: Summary
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the alert summary. This value populates the Alert Details field.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the alert summary. This value populates the Alert Details field.

parameters.name: target
parameters.title: Target
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the target host information, in the JSON format: {"target": {...}}. For all the relevant JSON fields and for more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the target host information, in the JSON format: {"target": {...}}. For all the relevant JSON fields and for more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.

parameters.name: threat_info
parameters.title: Threat Info
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the threat information, in the JSON format: {"threat_info": {...}}. For all the relevant JSON fields and for more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the threat information, in the JSON format: {"threat_info": {...}}. For all the relevant JSON fields and for more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.

parameters.name: custom_fields
parameters.title: Custom Fields
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a JSON object for collecting custom name-value pairs as part of the JSON alert sent to Proofpoint Threat Response, in the format: {"custom_fields": {...}}. Although there is no limit to the number of custom fields, Proofpoint recommends keeping this to 10 or fewer fields. For all the relevant JSON fields and for more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.
parameters.tooltip: Specify a JSON object for collecting custom name-value pairs as part of the JSON alert sent to Proofpoint Threat Response, in the format: {"custom_fields": {...}}. Although there is no limit to the number of custom fields, Proofpoint recommends keeping this to 10 or fewer fields. For all the relevant JSON fields and for more information, see the Proofpoint TRAP documentation under JSON Alert Source 2.0.
